note: Six fictional clubs in an unnamed desert metro (spec §18, OPEN_QUESTIONS #14). Names, attractions and quality are proposals.

clubs.name: FC Batavia
clubs.attraction: A new team with a coach who teaches the game and gives young players real minutes.

clubs.name: Sonoran United
clubs.attraction: The strongest youth program in the valley: tournament wins, exposure and a full-time technical staff.

clubs.name: Camelback Athletic
clubs.attraction: Superb individual technical coaching; every player leaves a better dribbler.

clubs.name: Mesa Verde SC
clubs.attraction: A family club with the best facilities in the east valley and a calm, patient culture.

clubs.name: Saguaro Rangers
clubs.attraction: Play everyone, travel little, and win more than people expect.

clubs.name: Red Rock FC
clubs.attraction: A goalkeeper-first academy whose coaches once played in the professional game.
